name: suite-sparse
scope: sparse matrix dimensions and nonzero count from a real coordinate Matrix Market file
family_note: C and C++ call sites share the same SuiteSparse CHOLMOD Check parser and installed library.

name: lis
scope: 3×3 symmetric Matrix Market matrix dimensions and three nonzeros
family_note: Lis C and C++ call sites share one native lis_input_mm parser. Its matrix API requires a square matrix for this control.

name: hypre
scope: 2x3 real coordinate matrix, three nonzeros, entry (1,3) = -2
family: HYPRE native IJ Matrix Market reader
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same HYPRE_IJMatrixReadMM native implementation.

name: lagraph
scope: 2x3 real coordinate matrix, three nonzeros, entry (1,3) = -2
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same LAGraph_MMRead implementation, backed by SuiteSparse GraphBLAS for matrix storage. Distinct parser from CHOLMOD Check.

name: librsb
scope: 2x3 real coordinate matrix, three nonzeros, entry (1,3) = -2
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same native rsb_file_mtx_load implementation in librsb 1.3.0.3.

name: superlu
scope: 3x3 real symmetric coordinate matrix, three diagonal nonzeros, entry (3,3) = 3
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same installed SuperLU dreadMM implementation; it requires a square input matrix. SuperLU_DIST has a closely related reader in a separate package and build.

name: superlu-dist
scope: 3x3 real symmetric coordinate matrix, three diagonal nonzeros, entry (3,3) = 3
family_note: Separate SuperLU_DIST package and build; its dreadMM_dist implementation is closely related to SuperLU dreadMM. C and C++ adapters call the same SuperLU_DIST parser.

name: gsl
scope: 2x3 real general coordinate matrix, three nonzeros, entry (1,3) = -2; the reader skips rather than validates the banner
family: GNU GSL sparse Matrix Market reader
family_note: C and C++ adapters call the same GSL 2.8 gsl_spmatrix_fscanf implementation. It handles one-based coordinate entries and comments; the 2.8 implementation does not validate the Matrix Market banner.

name: bebop-smc
license_evidence: https://bebop.cs.berkeley.edu/smc/ and COPYING in official dated source archive
scope: 2x3 real general coordinate matrix, three entries and value at (1,3)
family: BeBOP Sparse Matrix Converter reader with bundled NIST mmio banner parser
family_note: BeBOP has its own read_mm.c coordinate-entry reader and bundles a Matrix Market mmio.c banner/size parser; this is one package path and a distinct API from SuiteSparse/other solver libraries.

name: libmtx
input_api: mtxfile_read(struct mtxfile *, mtx_double, local filename, false, &lines, &bytes)
scope: 2x3 real general coordinate matrix, three nonzeros and value at (1,3)
family: Libmtx native Matrix Market file parser
family_note: Distinct tagged C library and local file API, parsing banner, size and entries. Its zero observed repository stars are not comparable to the cell's Homebrew requested-install metric.

name: nist-mmio
scope: Matrix Market real general coordinate banner, dimensions, three entries and value at (1,3)
family: NIST Matrix Market ANSI C mmio reference reader
family_note: The NIST mmio routines are independently published source files and the reference lineage copied into several later packages; those package paths are recorded separately where verified.

name: spm
scope: 3x3 real symmetric coordinate matrix, three diagonal nonzeros and entry (3,3) = 3; rectangular dimensions are not faithfully represented by this reader
family: SPM readMM with bundled Matrix Market mmio banner/size reader
family_note: Separate SolverStack SPM release, also used by PaStiX. Its native entry reader calls a bundled mmio implementation related to NIST mmio; the SPM package path is counted once.
